Bill.BriefDescription: Allowing second class cities and towns to pay claims by check or warrant.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to payment of claims by checks or warrants; addinga new section to chapter 35.23 RCW; and adding a new section to chapter35.27 RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 35.23 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: A second class city, by ordinance, may adopt a policy for thepayment of claims or other obligations of the city, which are payableout of solvent funds, electing to pay such obligations by warrant or bycheck. However, when the applicable fund is not solvent at the timepayment is ordered, a warrant shall be issued. When checks are to beused, the legislative body shall designate the qualified publicdepositary, upon which such checks are to be drawn, and the officersauthorized or required to sign such checks. Wherever a reference ismade to warrants in this title, such term shall include checks whereauthorized by this section.

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 35.27 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: A town, by ordinance, may adopt a policy for the payment of claimsor other obligations of the town, which are payable out of solventfunds, electing to pay such obligations by warrant or by check.However, when the applicable fund is not solvent at the time payment isordered, a warrant shall be issued. When checks are to be used, thelegislative body shall designate the qualified public depositary, uponwhich such checks are to be drawn, and the officers authorized orrequired to sign such checks. Wherever a reference is made to warrantsin this title, such term shall include checks where authorized by thissection.
